Elena Ramos: FYI — Skylark account: usage down ~73% over the last 10 days, spike in failed auths, and I see a new vendor trial in their SSO logs. Not great ahead of renewal.
OpsBot: [alert] account: skylark-corp — metric: tokens_per_day dropped 73% (10d). Linked dashboard: https://dash.redwood/example/skylark — suspected external trial (sso_match: vendor-x).
Ravi Patel: ack. ACV on this one? who owns renewal? @Elena Ramos can you drop a quick summary for me to share with the AM? :eyes:
Elena Ramos: ACV ~ $180k. Renewal in 6w. Champion (Claire) moved teams last week. I put raw metrics below and a short note.

Tomás Nguyen: thx. Do we know which endpoints dropped? embeddings or gen? If it's embeddings-only, cheaper to remediate with quota checks. I can pull per-route logs.
Elena Ramos: primary drop is generation (chat API) — embeddings steady. Also saw a few 403s from one IP block then a flurry of new OIDC app registrations.
Priya Singh: schedule a quick runbook: 1) confirm vendor trial 2) reach out to new PM/CTO 3) enable short-term credits/seat flex 4) collect usage examples they still need. I can lead customer outreach if Elena + Ravi want to join.
Ravi Patel: please do. Elena, can you post the contact list? I'll prep AM talking points and a small offer.
Elena Ramos: Contacts: Claire (former champion) — claire@skylark.com (now Product Ops), new PM = Jonas Kim — jonas@skylark.com, CTO = priya.cto@skylark.com. I pinged Jonas already but no reply.
Tomás Nguyen: I'll pull last 30 days of route+user-agent logs and check for vendor-x UA string. ETA 2h.
Priya Singh: I'll set a 30m call template and draft an incentive: 2 weeks free burst credits + a dedicated onboarding session. Also prepare a short doc comparing our latency/cost vs vendor-x for their workload.
Ravi Patel: want a one-pager we can surface to procurement — highlight cost predictability, SLA, private deployment option. Elena, can you surface top 3 frustrated workflows from their tickets?
Elena Ramos: Top 3: 1) prompt latency spikes during peak 2) occasional partial responses 3) complexity routing for multi-model pipeline. I added links to tickets in the thread.
Elena Ramos: Ticket snippets: "...responses truncating mid-sentence during model switch"; "latency goes from 200ms to 2s when batch size increases".
OpsBot: note: customer_support:open_tickets=4, recent_severity=high, last_support_response=2026-03-18T15:22:10Z.
Priya Singh: Plan: outreach + competitive deck + quick tech deep dive w/ Tomás. Assignments: Elena (context + tickets), Tomás (logs + perf diff), Ravi (one-pager + procurement), Priya (customer outreach + incentive). Meeting: target within 48h.
Ravi Patel: +1. I'll loop in Sales Ops for procurement concession approvals.
Elena Ramos: I'll draft a 5-slide sync for tomorrow morning. Posting meeting poll now. :calendar:
Tomás Nguyen: pulling logs now. If we see vendor-x calling their endpoints, that's our priority: confirm and push back w/ cost/latency comparison.
Priya Singh: thanks team. If we can't re-engage champion, escalate to exec sponsor before renewal (flagging via CSM playbook). :triage:
